title: UIDL Document
description: The top-level contract for a UIDL screen: one page of declarative UI. Mirrors the reference runtime's DocumentSchema and is deliberately permissive about the data-bearing fields so every shipped document validates; strictness lives in the focused expression/binding/action schemas and conformance fixtures.

$schema.description: Identifier for the schema a document was written against; informational, never fetched.

route.description: The route this document serves (see semantics/navigation.md).

theme.description: A theme preset name (string) or an inline theme object (see schema/theme.schema.json).

state.description: Initial values for the `state` scope (see semantics/state.md).

dataSources.description: Declared datasets: `data.<key>` names to inline arrays or `$query` descriptors (see semantics/queries.md).

definitions.description: Reusable node fragments referenced by tree nodes.
